title: Saltwater Dreams | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Saltwater Dreams is a Seagrove condo with lake views, bikes, a waterfront pool, and a short ride to the beach, shopping, and dining along 30A.
description_expanded: Welcome to Saltwater Dreams. Water views! Enjoy the beauty of the community lake from the comfort of the screened in patio. This well-appointed condo is in the private gated Seagrove Highlands community, centrally located in the heart of Seagrove along prestigious Highway 30A. Only 2-minute bike ride to the beach and walking distance to shopping and dining on 30A.
